name: mosquitto-rpc
notes: Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure mosquitto (release 065: brings up Mosquitto 2.0.20 on VM-B with docker compose, starts the plant and the reference device on VM-E: python3 conformance/reference/mqtt_device.py --broker 192.168.107.152:1883 --device pump-mqtt-1 --plant http://127.0.0.1:18090 --admin-port 18201). The fault proxy runs inside the probe on VM-C (no Toxiproxy); keepalive_s 60 exceeds the longest injected delay (P9T: 31.5 s).
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
